column1: # Per-file minutes for the self-hosted differential shards of tests/internal
# scripts/bootstrap/differential_shard.sh, which assigns files to shards by
# longest-processing-time first: heaviest file first, each onto the shard with
# the least predicted time so far.
# Format: <path> <minutes>, whitespace-separated. Blank lines and `#` ignored.
# Each value is the SLOWEST of the per-file times (the `::group::<file>` block's
# start to its `::endgroup::`) on develop batteries 41337442878 (dc24349c5),
# finished). Runner speed differs by up to 2x between jobs of ONE battery
# (verifier_ghost: 13.1, 6.5 and 11.6 min), so the slowest sample is the one to
# A file missing here gets the script's default weight (10 minutes, about one
# compiler-sized file) and a `::warning::`; add its measured time when the
# next battery shows it. A listed file that no longer exists is ignored.
# NOTE the `.tsv` extension: `.gitignore` has a blanket `*.txt` rule.
